minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  February 12, 2019

The Housing Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, January 29, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority, and
Finance Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Finance
Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a
quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Joint Powers
  Authority Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members/Housing Authority Members/Finance
  Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Joint Powers Authority
officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Wanda Brown  City Treasurer/Treasurer*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance Authority,
and Joint Powers Authority

CONFIRMATION OF BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND OFFICERS OF THE
INGLEWOOD POWERS AUTHORITY. The City Council, City Clerk, City
Treasurer, City Attorney, City Manager, and Assistant City Manager were sworn in as the
Official Board and Officers of the Inglewood Joint Powers Authority by Aisha
Thompson, Deputy City Clerk.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority/Finance Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Authority
Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the
City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Joint Powers on
any item on the Agenda.

There was no response.

HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Housing Authority Member
Morales, and seconded by Housing Authority Member Padilla that the Minutes from the
Housing Authority Meeting held on January 29, 2019, be approved. The motion was
carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Housing Authority Member Morales, Dotson, Morales, and Franklin and Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts; and
Noes: None.

There being no further business to be presented, Housing Authority Chairman Butts
declared the meeting adjourned in memory of Xavier Patterson at the hour of 3:00 p.m.
 February 12, 2019

  Approved this 12th day of March, 2019

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary
  ________________________
